The temporal compound כאשר is rendered jointly by “as soon as.” Splitting כ as “as soon” and אשר as the final “as” is imaginable, but assigns the immediacy of the whole temporal construction to כ alone without a distinct contextual basis; removing “soon” diminishes the compound rather than one morpheme's own rendering. Retain one noncompositional unit under rules 2 and 30. Rule 23 heads the particle compound on its governing כ; the opening “as” anchors that relation under rule 24, rather than the closing clause-linking “as.”
